title: More: Mode-Optimized Reasoning with Self-Adaptive Effort for Self-Evolving Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.33684v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-evolving training improves the performance of agents on difficult tasks through verifiable feedback, but it often applies costly deliberation uniformly across tasks. To address this problem, we propose Mode-Optimized Reasoning with Self-Adaptive Effort (MORE), a self-evolving training framework that adaptively selects both reasoning form and computational effort for each task. Specifically, MORE follows a two-stage training paradigm: (i) \emph{Stage 1} establishes a compact prior over direct answering, short and long chain-of-thought, and code-based reasoning, and (ii) \emph{Stage 2} self-evolves this prior with Mode-Adaptive and Test-time Effort PPO (MATE-PPO) on generated, verifiable task streams without curated data. By learning mode selection and token expenditure jointly, MORE allocates concise reasoning to tasks that permit it while retaining extended deliberation where it is useful. translated_title: MORE：面向自我进化智能体的自适应努力模式优化推理
translated_abstract: 自我进化训练通过可验证的反馈提升智能体在困难任务上的表现，但它通常在所有任务上统一应用代价高昂的深度推理。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了具有自适应努力的模式优化推理（MORE），这是一个自我进化训练框架，能够为每个任务自适应地选择推理形式和计算努力。具体而言，MORE遵循两阶段训练范式：(i) 第一阶段在直接回答、短链和长链思维以及基于代码的推理上建立紧凑的先验分布；(ii) 第二阶段使用模式自适应与测试时努力PPO（MATE-PPO）在生成的、可验证的任务流上对该先验进行自我进化，无需人工策划的数据。通过联合学习模式选择和token消耗，MORE为允许简洁推理的任务分配简洁的推理方式，同时在需要的地方保留扩展的深度思考。在编程、数学和通用推理……
tldr: 提出MORE自我进化训练框架，通过MATE-PPO使智能体能为每个任务自适应地选择推理模式（直接回答、短/长思维链或代码推理）和计算努力，在保持性能的同时优化token消耗。
en_tdlr: MORE is a self-evolving training framework that uses MATE-PPO to adaptively select both the reasoning mode and computational effort for each task, allocating concise reasoning where possible while retaining extended deliberation where useful.
